note: Mobbin UI/UX reference library (mobbin.design 301s here). Sitemap 3130 locs; the item families are the explore leaves /explore/<platform>/<kind>/<name> — 1416 pages in three platforms (web, mobile, sites) and their kinds (screens, flows, ui-elements, app-categories, categories, sections, styles), e.g. /explore/web/screens/code-editor ('Code Editor Screen UI Examples and Roundups'), /explore/sites/sections/video-section, /explore/mobile/flows/onboarding. The match is generic (/explore/{*}/{*}/{name}) rather than the 09 draft's three literal templates: web and mobile share the slug of the same kind (deleting-deactivating-account is both a web and a mobile flow, 242 such pairs), and only a captured platform segment keeps them apart in the item id. The /explore/screens/<uuid> pages linked from the explore indexes are left out (coordinator, 2026-10-07): their only name would be the uuid, useless for search. /colors/* (1563 colour-name pages) is left out on purpose, as are the indexes and the blog/changelog/glossary families. Anonymous surface — the upsell asks to join for flows/collections, no screen content sits behind a wall.
